description: Implement the rich, responsive React UI for BOTH flows on top of the FEAT-001 scaffold, preserving 100% of the existing functionality and the exact API/auth contract. Public flow: card-based quiz list, quiz-taking screen with a progress indicator, and an engaging result screen with per-question correct/incorrect feedback (using the answerIndex returned by submit to show the right answer). Admin flow: Cognito Hosted UI login/logout, an authenticated dynamic quiz-builder form with the SAME validation rules and the SAME answerIndex-over-non-empty-options semantics, sessionStorage token handling, and 401/403 handling. Also delete the old vanilla frontend files. Depends on FEAT-001.
steps: ROUTING DECISION (resolves the FEAT-001 follow-up about /admin vs /admin.html): the CDK (lib/quiz-app-stack.ts, DO NOT change it) registers the Cognito Hosted UI callback/logout URLs as `<baseUrl>/admin.html` and `http://localhost:8080/admin.html`. Cognito requires an EXACT redirect_uri match, so the React admin page MUST be served at the URL path /admin.html. Convert the Vite app to a MULTI-PAGE build with two HTML entry points at the Vite root: frontend/index.html (mounts the public app) and frontend/admin.html (mounts the admin app). Update frontend/vite.config.ts build.rollupOptions.input = { main: 'index.html', admin: 'admin.html' } (use path.resolve(__dirname, ...)). This removes the need for react-router-dom AND for any Amplify SPA rewrite rule, since both pages are real static files. Remove react-router-dom from frontend/package.json dependencies and delete the router usage from src/main.tsx and src/App.tsx (replace with two entry modules).

Create frontend/admin.html (Vite root, sibling of index.html): same head as index.html but クイズ管理者ページ, a
, and . Rename/replace src/main.tsx so the public entry is src/main.tsx rendering (no router) into #root, and add src/admin-main.tsx rendering into #root. Delete src/App.tsx (no longer needed) or repurpose it; ensure no dangling import of react-router-dom remains anywhere. Both entries import './styles.css'.

Implement frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx as the public quiz flow using the api client from src/api.ts. Manage view state ('list' | 'quiz' | 'result') and a status/error line (mirror the old setStatus semantics incl. an error style). On mount, call getQuizzes() and render a rich card-based list: each quiz as a clickable card showing title and 'ぜん N もん'/'全N問' question count (keep the old '（全N問）' wording). Empty state: 'クイズがありません。'. Errors: show the thrown Error.message in the status line with error styling.

In HomePage, on selecting a quiz call getQuiz(quizId) and render the quiz-taking screen: show the title, a progress indicator (e.g. answered X / total, or a step bar), and each question (q.n, q.text) with its options as radio inputs grouped by name 'q'+q.n. Track selected answers in state keyed by q.n. Provide '回答する' (submit) and '一覧に戻る' (back to list) actions. On submit, build answers = quiz.questions.map(q => selected[q.n] ?? -1) (an array of numbers, -1 for unanswered, matching old app.js) and call submitAnswers(quizId, answers).

In HomePage, render an engaging result screen from SubmitResult: prominent score 'score / total' (keep the old '正解数: X / Y' text available, styled richly e.g. a score ring/percentage), and a per-question breakdown list marking each q.n correct/incorrect with color (green/red) mirroring old '.correct'/'.incorrect'. Use result.results[].answerIndex (returned by the submit endpoint) plus the loaded quiz question options to also SHOW the correct option text for wrong answers (a richness improvement; keep it robust if a question is missing). Provide 'もう一度クイズを選ぶ' to reload the list.

Implement frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx as the admin flow using src/auth.ts + src/api.ts. On mount: restoreToken() then captureTokenFromHash() (handle the returned error by showing 'ログインに失敗しました: <error>'); derive isAuthenticated = token present and Date.now() < expiresAt. Render a login view when unauthenticated ('クイズを登録するにはログインが必要です。' + 'ログイン' button that navigates to loginUrl(); a link back to the public app) and the admin view when authenticated (a 'ログアウト' button navigating to logoutUrl() after clearToken(); a link back to the public app).

In AdminPage, implement the dynamic quiz-builder form with React state (not manual DOM building). State: title, optional quizId, and a list of questions where each question has text and a list of option rows (each option row has text and an isCorrect flag; correctness is single-select per question like a radio). Controls: 'タイトル' input; 'クイズ ID（任意 / 半角英数字とハイフン）' input; per question a 'this question' fieldset with a '問題文' input, 2-4 option rows each with a correct radio + text input + a '削除' button (disabled when only 2 rows remain, min 2 enforced), a '選択肢を追加' button (max 4), and a 'この問題を削除' button; a '問題を追加' button; a '登録する' submit button. Start with one question having two empty option rows (mirror old initial state).

In AdminPage, implement collectPayload() mirroring the old admin.js validation EXACTLY, throwing Error with the SAME Japanese messages: title required ('タイトルを入力してください。'); >=1 question ('問題を 1 つ以上追加してください。'); each question text required ('問題 N の問題文を入力してください。'); build options from NON-EMPTY trimmed option texts, require >=2 ('問題 N には空でない選択肢を 2 つ以上入力してください。'); a correct option must be selected ('問題 N の正解を選択してください。'); compute answerIndex over ONLY the non-empty options (skip blanks when counting, exactly like the old code) and if the selected correct row is blank error 'problem N の正解は空でない選択肢を選んでください。' (use the exact old string '問題 N の正解は空でない選択肢を選んでください。'); optional quizId must match /^[a-z0-9-]+$/ else 'クイズ ID は半角英小文字・数字・ハイフンのみ使用できます。'. Payload shape { title, questions:[{text, options, answerIndex}], quizId? }.

In AdminPage submit handler: preventDefault; run collectPayload() (on throw show message in status with error style and stop); re-check isAuthenticated (if not, show 'ログインが必要です（認証エラー）' and switch to login view); set status '登録中...'; call createQuiz(payload, idToken). On AuthError/401 clear the token, switch to login view, show 'ログインが必要です（認証エラー）'. On 403 show '権限がありません'. On success render a result panel: heading 'クイズを登録しました。' (green), a line 'クイズ ID: / 問題数: ', and a plain クイズアプリで確認する link back to the public app (mirror old admin.js; use a relative href since there is no router). Provide navigation between the public page and the admin page via plain links (public page links to admin.html, admin page links to index.html), matching the old vanilla '管理者ページ' / 'クイズアプリに戻る' links.

Delete the old vanilla frontend files now fully superseded: frontend/app.js, frontend/admin.js, frontend/config.js, frontend/styles.css. (frontend/index.html and frontend/admin.html now exist as the NEW Vite multi-page entry HTML files, replacing the old vanilla ones.) Confirm no remaining reference to app.js/admin.js/config.js/the-old-styles.css exists in amplify.yml, README.md, or anywhere in the repo (grep).

Update README.md (Japanese) to reflect the final routing decision: the admin page is served at /admin.html (a real static entry, matching the existing Cognito callback URLs), so NO Amplify SPA rewrite rule is needed and the CDK Cognito callback/logout URLs (already <baseUrl>/admin.html) need NO change. If FEAT-001's README mentioned a /admin client-side route or an SPA rewrite requirement, correct it here.

Ensure the whole frontend type-checks and builds under Vite multi-page: both index.html and admin.html are declared inputs; src/main.tsx and src/admin-main.tsx mount the correct page; no dangling react-router-dom import anywhere; strict TypeScript passes (no untyped anys). Validated by reading in-sandbox and by `npm run build` on the user's machine (which must emit dist/index.html AND dist/admin.html).
acceptance_criteria: Public flow works end to end against the real API contract: list (cards) -> take quiz (radios + progress indicator) -> submit builds answers:number[] with -1 for unanswered -> result screen shows score/total and per-question correct/incorrect with color, using submit's answerIndex to reveal correct options.

Admin flow works end to end: Cognito Hosted UI login (implicit grant) captures id_token from the hash into sessionStorage with the 60s margin, authenticated create-quiz form posts Authorization: Bearer <id_token> to POST {API_BASE}/admin/quizzes, logout uses the Cognito logout URL, and 401 (clear+re-login) / 403 (permission denied) are handled.
The admin form's validation and the answerIndex-over-non-empty-options computation produce byte-identical payloads and identical Japanese error messages to the old admin.js for equivalent input.

The admin page is served at /admin.html (Vite multi-page entry), so the Cognito redirect_uri (origin + '/admin.html') exactly matches the CDK-registered callback/logout URLs with NO CDK change and NO Amplify SPA rewrite needed.

The UI is visually rich and responsive: card-based list, progress indicator, engaging result screen, mobile-friendly layout, and dark-mode support (from FEAT-001 styles), with a lean dependency count (react + react-dom only; react-router-dom removed).
All old vanilla JS/CSS files (frontend/app.js, admin.js, config.js, styles.css) are removed and nothing in the repo references them; index.html and admin.html are the new Vite entries.
`cd frontend && npm run build` (on the user's networked machine) type-checks (tsc -b, strict) and produces frontend/dist containing index.html AND admin.html with no errors.
verification: In-sandbox: read HomePage.tsx and AdminPage.tsx and confirm the API calls, answers array construction (-1 for unanswered), result rendering, Cognito login/logout URLs, token capture/margin, sessionStorage key, and the collectPayload validation + answerIndex-over-non-empty-options logic match lambda/index.ts and the old app.js/admin.js exactly (including the exact Japanese strings).

In-sandbox: grep the whole repo to confirm no reference remains to app.js/admin.js/config.js and the old vanilla styles.css, that react-router-dom is fully removed, and that index.html + admin.html are declared as Vite inputs in vite.config.ts.
In-sandbox: reason through TypeScript strictness (no untyped anys) so the build would pass; confirm both entry modules (main.tsx, admin-main.tsx) mount the correct page.

On networked machine (documented for user): `cd frontend && env -u NODE_OPTIONS npm install && env -u NODE_OPTIONS npm run build` succeeds and emits frontend/dist; manual smoke test of both flows against a deployed API.
findings: Implemented the rich React UI for both flows on top of the FEAT-001 scaffold, authored entirely by hand (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY: npm registry 403, so npm install / vite build / tsc could NOT run in-sandbox; verified correct-by-construction by reading + JSON validity checks with `env -u NODE_OPTIONS node`). ROUTING: converted to a Vite MULTI-PAGE build. vite.config.ts now sets build.rollupOptions.input = { main: resolve(__dirname,'index.html'), admin: resolve(__dirname,'admin.html') }. Added frontend/admin.html (title 'クイズ管理者ページ', #root, /src/admin-main.tsx). src/main.tsx renders (no router); new src/admin-main.tsx renders ; both import './styles.css'. REMOVED react-router-dom from package.json deps and deleted src/App.tsx; grep confirms zero react-router-dom references remain. Navigation is plain /. Because admin is served at the real static file /admin.html, the Cognito redirect_uri (origin + '/admin.html') exactly matches the CDK-registered callback/logout URLs, so NO CDK change and NO Amplify SPA rewrite are needed. PUBLIC FLOW (HomePage.tsx): view state list|quiz|result; card-based quiz list (empty 'クイズがありません。', count '（全N問）'); quiz-taking screen with a progress indicator (回答済み X / total + progress bar) and radios grouped by name 'q'+q.n; submit builds answers = quiz.questions.map(q => q.n in selected ? selected[q.n] : -1) as number[] with -1 for unanswered (mirrors app.js); result screen shows a conic-gradient score ring + percentage, the exact old '正解数: X / Y' line, and per-question 正解/不正解 with green/red color, additionally revealing the correct option text on wrong answers via result.results[].answerIndex (robust bounds-checked against the loaded quiz options). Status line mirrors old setStatus incl. .error style. ADMIN FLOW (AdminPage.tsx): on mount restoreToken() then captureTokenFromHash() (shows 'ログインに失敗しました: ' on OAuth error); isAuthenticated = token && Date.now() < expiresAt; login view ('クイズを登録するにはログインが必要です。' + 'ログイン' -> loginUrl()); authenticated view with 'ログアウト' (clearToken() then logoutUrl()). Dynamic quiz-builder in React state: title, optional quizId, questions[] each with text + 2-4 option rows (single-select correct radio, '削除' disabled at 2 rows, '選択肢を追加' capped at 4, 'この問題を削除', '問題を追加', '登録する'); starts with 1 question / 2 empty options. collectPayload() mirrors admin.js EXACTLY incl. byte-identical Japanese errors ('タイトルを入力してください。', '問題を 1 つ以上追加してください。', '問題 N の問題文を入力してください。', '問題 N には空でない選択肢を 2 つ以上入力してください。', '問題 N の正解を選択してください。', '問題 N の正解は空でない選択肢を選んでください。', 'クイズ ID は半角英小文字・数字・ハイフンのみ使用できます。') and computes answerIndex over ONLY non-empty options (skipping blanks when counting the checked DOM index). Submit: preventDefault; collectPayload (errors -> status.error); re-check auth ('ログインが必要です（認証エラー）' + back to login); status '登録中...'; createQuiz(payload, idToken). AuthError/401 -> clearToken + login view + 'ログインが必要です（認証エラー）'; 403 -> '権限がありません' (surfaced via api.ts Error). Success -> result panel: 'クイズを登録しました。' (green), 'クイズ ID: / 問題数: ', and クイズアプリで確認する. CLEANUP: git rm'd frontend/app.js, admin.js, config.js, and the OLD top-level styles.css (src/styles.css untouched, only extended with rich UI classes). grep confirms no functional references to the deleted files remain (only descriptive code comments and the read-only lib/quiz-app-stack.ts comment mentioning frontend/config.js, which must not be modified). Updated amplify.yml comment + README.md (Japanese) to state admin is at /admin.html, no SPA rewrite and no CDK change needed, correcting FEAT-001's /admin client-side-route + SPA-rewrite text. DEPS now react + react-dom only. STRICT TS: used explicit type-only imports (type FormEvent, CSSProperties, and API types) under isolatedModules; CSS custom property set via `{ '--percent': percent } as CSSProperties`; no untyped anys. VERIFICATION STILL REQUIRED ON NETWORKED MACHINE: `cd frontend && npm install && npm run build` must type-check (tsc -b) and emit frontend/dist containing BOTH index.html AND admin.html. Note: vite.config.ts uses __dirname/path.resolve, resolved by @types/node (devDep) + the standard Vite CJS-interop config loader; this is the canonical Vite multi-page pattern.
